description: This file contains CMake functions for converting JSON-encoded strings into CMake strings, handling escape sequences and quotation marks.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a JSON string to a CMake string by removing quotes and processing escape sequences.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: Calls json_string_to_cmake on a reference to a JSON string and returns the result.
